description: This file defines an internal struct CommitQueue<T> in the Orleans.Transactions namespace, implementing a circular buffer to store transaction records sorted by timestamps, with methods for adding, removing, and searching entries.

classes.name: CommitQueue<T>
classes.description: A queue data structure using a circular buffer to manage transaction records, maintaining timestamp order, with methods for addition, removal, and search.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new transaction record to the queue, resizing the buffer if necessary, and ensuring entries are added in timestamp order.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the queue, resetting buffer state.

methods.name: RemoveFromFront
methods.description: Removes a specified number of entries from the front of the queue.

methods.name: RemoveFromBack
methods.description: Removes a specified number of entries from the back of the queue.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Performs a binary search to locate a transaction record by transaction ID and timestamp within the queue.
